entries.english: Forced - When an enemy spawns at this location: Reveal this location.
entries.zhCn: 强制 - 在敌人生成在本地点时：揭示本地点。

entries.english: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.
entries.zhCn: [action]：探索。抽取探索牌库顶的一张卡牌。如果该卡牌是一个连接地点，将其放置入场，并移动到该地点。
